Interface FileTransformPlan

All Known Implementing Classes:
AbstractFileTransformPlan
public sealed interface FileTransformPlan permits AbstractFileTransformPlan
A FileTransformPlan provides all methods to the transformations. All transformations start with calling the transformation result for a filename. All other methods use the input filename as context to be able to do their transformation.
